purpose: Standing RELION-vs-relax resolution and wall-time table for every synthetic and real dataset run so far. relax is the RECOVAR EM code; rows before the relax split (2026-09-23) cite the RECOVAR source SHA that ran. Rendered by scripts/render_benchmark_table.py into docs/benchmarks/relion_vs_relax.md.
rules: Missing measurements are null and carry a reason in null_reasons; no value is interpolated or invented.
Each resolution value names its definition (see resolution_definitions); a column mixing definitions is footnoted in the rendered table.
time_ratio_relax_over_relion is relax wall / RELION wall from the two wall_s fields of the row, rounded to two decimals, or null with a reason.
One current row per configuration. history lists older numbers already recorded in docs/math/em_parity_best_metrics.md or run reports for the same workflow.

resolution_definitions.scorecard_band: Unmasked, unaligned half-map FSC; first three-shell-sustained crossing below 1/7; resolution = box * pixel / crossing shell (docs/math/em_k1_realdata_science_equivalence_scorecard.md).
resolution_definitions.half_fsc_0143: Unmasked half-map FSC 0.143 of the final unfiltered half maps.
resolution_definitions.relion_postprocess_unmasked: relion_postprocess unmasked FSC 0.143 of the final half maps.
resolution_definitions.engine_current_resolution: The engine's own current-resolution estimate at the last iteration (RELION rlnCurrentResolution; RECOVAR log 'Res A'). For Class3D this is not a gold-standard FSC.
resolution_definitions.relion_postprocess_masked_frozen: relion_postprocess rlnFinalResolution of the phase-randomisation-corrected masked half-map FSC, computed with the dataset's frozen mask and one fixed protocol (docs/benchmarks/masked_fsc_method.md); RELION's convention, the last shell before the first corrected value below 0.143.
resolution_definitions.vdam_fsc05_vs_reference: InitialModel (VDAM): FSC 0.5 of the rigidly registered final map against the reference (ground truth for synthetic data, RELION's auto-refine map of the same data for real data); first shell below 0.5, as box * pixel / shell; K>1: the most populated class. No half maps, so not a gold-standard resolution.

matched_definition.yes: Same GPU model and node type, box, particles, schedule and flags, with both arms run cold (empty compile cache, standalone start-up); the arms may run in one job (--gres=gpu:2, one arm per GPU) or in separate jobs, nodes or dates (user, 2026-09-29). Earlier rows measured on exclusive nodes or as ABBA repeats remain valid.
matched_definition.workload: Same GPU model, box, particles and schedule, but an arm was not run cold (for example a shared or warm compile cache) or the hardware differs, so the time ratio is not a speed comparison.
matched_definition.no: Workload or schedule differs, or one side has no wall time, so the time ratio is not a speed comparison.
matched_definition.check: For every row with a ratio, time_check records (a) RELION GPU count and MPI ranks and relax GPU count, (b) relax diagnostic, capture, deterministic-reduction, RELION-state replay and per-iteration dump options, (c) whether each wall is end-to-end including start-up and compilation, (d) the GPU model per job from sacct node and nvidia-smi records.

initial_model_intro: InitialModel (VDAM) rows compare final InitialModel maps, which have no half maps and an arbitrary orientation and handedness. Every map is rigidly registered (HEALPix-2 seed with x-mirror, then a continuous rotation and translation fit, contrast sign +1; relax.diagnostics.gt_registration) before any FSC.

- **Ref FSC-AUC**: FSC-AUC (normalised trapezoid over shells 1 to Nyquist-2) of the aligned final map against the reference: ground truth for synthetic data, RELION's auto-refine map of the same data for real data (agreement with the refined structure, not a gold-standard resolution). Masked: both maps multiplied by the dataset's frozen mask.
- **Ref FSC 0.5**: first shell where that FSC falls below 0.5, as box * pixel / shell.

- **X-AUC**: FSC-AUC of relax's map fitted directly onto RELION's map, unmasked / masked. **RELION repeat X-AUC**: the same for two RELION runs of the same command (same or different seed, as noted); a relax-vs-RELION difference counts as RELION variation only when this band shows it.
- K>1: population-weighted means over Hungarian-matched classes; FSC 0.5 of the most populated class.

RELION `--preread_images` and VDAM walls: in auto-refine, pre-reading made RELION 1.7-5.2x slower per iteration. For relion_refine --grad no slowdown is seen. The same command on pdb K=4 5k/128, seed 29, took 927 s without pre-read (band job 14382132) vs 795 s (P3) and 970 s (2026-09-19) with it; on pdb K=2, 999 s without vs 989 s with. On EMPIAR-10097, pre-read runs took 3001/3080 s vs about 3800 s without (--j 4). Rows whose RELION arm pre-read are therefore not marked provisional; the evidence at 100k-130k particles is indirect.
Scoring: `scripts/score_initialmodel_maps.py` with `docs/benchmarks/initialmodel_scores/config.json` (CPU); per-run curves and fits: the `score_json` of each row.
